messages.subject: Appending files to existing ones
parts:
I am developing an app which accepts files as input, reads the data in them and returns the results. Because of the considerable time it takes to process the data in a single file, I want the user to select only the files he/she might need at an instance. When the files are selected the results are returned for the selected files. If the user wishes to process more files, he/she can select them and the results will be returned in a way that it is appended to the previous results i.e. if user has processed files A and B, and user wants to process files C and D, the results of C and D will be appended to that of A and B. Another feature I wish to add is that if the user selects a file which had previously been processed, it would not be processed since the result had been previously obtained (this is to remove redundancy). Here is a illustration of what I am trying to do for this purpose you can create about 4 files which has say 3 rows and 2 columns each, the function I chose in here is rbind, i.e. stacking the data. Try to check if you bring them in one by one, also check if processed files will not be processed):

        isolate({

                filePathLog <<- input$path$datapath

            } else{
                x <<- input$path$datapath
                setdiff(x,filePathLog)
            }
            
        })
    })
    
    output$address <- renderText({
       c(filePathLog,filePaths())

        if (input$ok == 0)
            return()
        isolate({
            if(is.null(initTable)){

                                  read.table,

                                  sep = ","
                            )
                initTable

                           read.table, 
                           header = FALSE,
                           sep = ","
                )
                rbind.data.frame(initTable,x)

        })

    output$testTable <- renderTable({
        createTable()

})
